etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Late Latin lēgislātiō (“the giving of the law”). Morphologically legislate +‎ -ion.

definitions.definition: The act of legislating; preparation and enactment of laws.
A law which has been enacted by legislature or other governing body.

quote.citation: 2003, Ruben E. Agpalo, Statutory Construction, page 467:
quote.text: The general rule is that constitutional provisions are self-executing, except when the provisions themselves expressly require legislations to implement them  […]

quote.citation: 2024 September 23, Soumya Karlamangla, “California Bans All Plastic Bags After Its First Effort Backfired”, in The New York Times‎[1]:
quote.text: Gov. Gavin Newsom signed legislation on Sunday banning the sale at grocery checkouts of all plastic bags, regardless of thickness.
